note: 24 节气 × 9 体质 = 216 条「今日」节气卡提示,中英各一句。每条针对该节气的气候特点与该体质的偏颇方向,给一个当天可执行的动作。顺序按通行节气序(立春=1 … 大寒=24)。草案由 AI 起草,正式入知识层前需中医顾问逐条核对;来源以《中医养生学》节气养生章节与《中医体质学》调体原则为据。
source: 《中医养生学》· 节气养生;《中医体质学》· 九种体质调体原则

pinghe.zh: 立春阳气初生,早起拉伸几分钟,早餐加点葱、芽菜助升发。
pinghe.en: Yang begins to rise at Start of Spring: stretch a few minutes on waking and add scallion or sprouts to breakfast.

qixu.zh: 春寒料峭最耗气,别急着减衣;早餐一碗山药小米粥,出门戴条围巾。
qixu.en: Early-spring chill drains qi — don't shed layers yet; yam-millet congee for breakfast and a scarf when you go out.

yangxu.zh: 立春只是名义上的春,阳虚者继续护好腰腹和脚,中午晒晒后背。
yangxu.en: Spring is only nominal at Start of Spring; keep lower back, belly and feet covered and sun your back at noon.

yinxu.zh: 春生易动肝火,少吃辛辣发物,今天多喝温水,晚上 23 点前睡。
yinxu.en: Rising spring energy stirs liver heat: skip spicy triggers, drink warm water today, lights out before 11.

tanshi.zh: 春天是化湿好时机,少吃甜腻,午饭后快走 20 分钟。
tanshi.en: Spring is the season to clear damp: fewer sweets and grease, a brisk 20-minute walk after lunch.

shire.zh: 立春别跟着吃辛辣“迎春”,清淡一天,多吃芽菜和绿叶。
shire.en: Skip the spicy spring feasting; keep today light with sprouts and greens.

xueyu.zh: 春主生发、血当流动,起床后活动肩背,工作中每小时起身 3 分钟。
xueyu.en: Spring is for movement and flowing blood: loosen shoulders on waking, stand up every hour.

qiyu.zh: 春应肝,是疏解情绪的最好时节:午后出门走走,把憋了一冬的话说出来。
qiyu.en: Spring belongs to the liver, the best time to unwind: get outside this afternoon and say what winter kept in.

tebing.zh: 花粉季将至,提前一周开始洗鼻,出门戴口罩,回家先洗脸换衣。
tebing.en: Pollen season is coming: start nasal rinses a week early, mask outdoors, wash face and change on return.

pinghe.zh: 雨水湿气渐重,饮食健脾为先,今天来点薏米或山药。
pinghe.en: Dampness grows at Rain Water: lead with spleen-friendly food — a little Job's tears or yam today.

qixu.zh: 乍暖还寒最易感冒,外套随身带;午后喝杯红枣姜茶。
qixu.en: Warm-cold swings invite colds: carry a jacket; red-date ginger tea in the afternoon.

yangxu.zh: 雨水寒湿并至,别穿湿鞋久坐,晚上泡脚加两片姜。
yangxu.en: Cold and damp arrive together: no sitting in damp shoes; add two ginger slices to tonight's foot soak.

yinxu.zh: 湿重但燥未退,银耳、百合可以继续,少熬夜。
yinxu.en: Damp rises but dryness lingers: keep the white fungus and lily bulb going, avoid late nights.

tanshi.zh: 雨水是痰湿体质的考验,今天少吃甜食,多走路,饭后别立刻坐下。
tanshi.en: Rain Water tests phlegm-damp types: fewer sweets today, more walking, don't sit right after meals.

shire.zh: 湿热渐起,饮食清淡利湿,少喝甜饮料和啤酒。
shire.en: Damp-heat stirs: eat light and damp-draining, skip sugary drinks and beer.

xueyu.zh: 阴雨天血行易滞,室内也要活动,做几节八段锦。
xueyu.en: Grey, wet days slow the blood: move indoors — a few Baduanjin movements.

qiyu.zh: 连绵阴雨容易闷闷不乐,开灯开窗,约人聊十分钟。
qiyu.en: Days of drizzle weigh on mood: open the curtains, turn on the lights, talk to someone for ten minutes.

tebing.zh: 潮湿助长尘螨和霉菌,今天通风、晒被,过敏源少一点。
tebing.en: Damp feeds dust mites and mold: air the room and sun the bedding today.

pinghe.zh: 惊蛰万物萌动,户外快走让阳气顺畅升发,晚饭吃点梨润一润。
pinghe.en: Everything stirs at Awakening of Insects: a brisk outdoor walk lifts yang; a pear after dinner moistens.

qixu.zh: 春困来袭别硬撑,午休 20 分钟;早餐别省,加个鸡蛋。
qixu.en: Spring fatigue hits — don't push through: a 20-minute nap, and don't skip breakfast; add an egg.

yangxu.zh: 惊蛰雷动寒未尽,早晚温差大,出门多带一层,回家喝碗热汤。
yangxu.en: Thunder comes but cold isn't gone: big swings, so carry a layer and have hot soup when home.

yinxu.zh: 惊蛰最易肝火上炎、口干目涩,多喝水,少看屏幕,早点睡。
yinxu.en: Liver heat flares at Awakening of Insects — dry mouth, dry eyes: drink more, less screen, sleep early.

tanshi.zh: 阳气上升正好化痰湿,今天出点微汗,少吃肥肉奶油。
tanshi.en: Rising yang helps clear phlegm-damp: work up a light sweat today, go easy on fatty food.

shire.zh: 春热渐起,易长痘口苦,今天忌辛辣烧烤,喝杯菊花茶。
shire.en: Spring heat brings acne and bitter taste: no spicy or grilled food today; a cup of chrysanthemum tea.

xueyu.zh: 惊蛰宜动不宜静,跳舞、快走都好,久坐是今天的大忌。
xueyu.en: Awakening of Insects favors motion over stillness: dance or walk briskly; sitting long is today's one no.

qiyu.zh: 春雷惊醒的不只是虫,还有情绪,今天做一件让自己舒畅的小事。
qiyu.en: Spring thunder wakes feelings too: do one small thing today that genuinely eases you.

tebing.zh: 花粉浓度上升,减少上午户外时间,回家后换衣洗脸,鼻腔冲洗。
tebing.en: Pollen climbs: less outdoor time in the morning; change, wash your face and rinse your nose when home.

pinghe.zh: 春分讲平衡,饮食寒热搭配,情绪也别大起大落,午后晒十分钟太阳。
pinghe.en: Spring Equinox is about balance: pair warming with cooling foods, keep moods even, ten minutes of afternoon sun.

qixu.zh: 春分后白天变长,别因此熬夜;气虚者更需要睡够,今晚 22:30 前上床。
qixu.en: Days lengthen after the equinox — don't let that steal sleep; qi deficiency needs it most, in bed by 10:30.

yangxu.zh: 春分阴阳相半,阳虚者趁势补阳:多晒太阳,午餐加点韭菜或姜。
yangxu.en: At the equinox yang can be built: more sun, and chives or ginger at lunch.

yinxu.zh: 平衡的日子最适合滋阴,今天来份枸杞菠菜,别吃辛辣。
yinxu.en: A balanced day suits nourishing yin: spinach with goji today, no spice.

tanshi.zh: 春分气候宜人,正适合运动减重,今天走够 8000 步。
tanshi.en: Equinox weather is ideal for exercise: aim for 8,000 steps today.

shire.zh: 春分饮食宜清不宜厚,少油少辣,多绿叶菜和豆腐。
shire.en: Keep equinox meals clean rather than rich: less oil and chili, more greens and tofu.

xueyu.zh: 昼夜平分、气血宜畅,早晚各活动十分钟,别让一天都坐着。
xueyu.en: Keep qi and blood flowing on this balanced day: ten minutes of movement morning and evening.

qiyu.zh: 春分是调情志的好日子,整理一下心情,写几句话或和朋友聊聊。
qiyu.en: The equinox is a good day to settle the mind: write a few lines or talk with a friend.

tebing.zh: 花粉高峰期,出门戴口罩和眼镜,晚上关窗开净化器。
tebing.en: Peak pollen: mask and glasses outdoors; windows shut and purifier on at night.

pinghe.zh: 清明踏青正当时,户外走走,但风大别受凉,饮食清淡柔润。
pinghe.en: Pure Brightness is for outings: get out, but mind the wind; eat light and moistening.

qixu.zh: 清明风大,气虚者易被风邪所伤,出门护好后颈,别在风口久站。
qixu.en: Pure Brightness winds easily hit qi deficiency: cover the back of the neck and don't linger in drafts.

yangxu.zh: 清明雨多寒湿重,阳虚者今天少吃生冷,晚上艾叶泡脚。
yangxu.en: Rain brings cold-damp at Pure Brightness: no raw or cold food today; mugwort foot soak tonight.

yinxu.zh: 柔肝养肺的时节,银耳、荠菜都适合;扫墓或远行注意补水。
yinxu.en: A time to soften the liver and nourish the lungs: white fungus and shepherd's purse suit; hydrate on outings.

tanshi.zh: 清明别吃太多青团糯食,黏腻生湿;多走路,少久坐。
tanshi.en: Go easy on glutinous festival treats — they breed damp; walk more, sit less.

shire.zh: 春末渐热,湿热体质少吃笋、海鲜等发物,清淡为主。
shire.en: Late spring warms up: damp-heat types should limit bamboo shoots and seafood; keep it light.

xueyu.zh: 踏青是活血良方,今天多走多动,但避免久站吹风。
xueyu.en: An outing is good medicine for stasis: walk and move today, but don't stand long in the wind.

qiyu.zh: 清明易生思念与郁结,允许自己感受,然后出门走走、见见人。
qiyu.en: Pure Brightness can bring longing and heaviness: let yourself feel it, then step out and see people.

tebing.zh: 柳絮花粉齐飞,过敏体质今天尽量室内活动,外出戴好口罩。
tebing.en: Catkins and pollen fill the air: stay indoors where you can; mask up when you must go out.

pinghe.zh: 谷雨雨多湿重,饮食健脾为先,饭后散步十分钟。
pinghe.en: Grain Rain is wet and damp: lead with spleen-strengthening food and a ten-minute walk after meals.

qixu.zh: 湿困脾气,气虚者今天别吃生冷瓜果,午饭加碗山药粥。
qixu.en: Damp burdens the spleen: no raw fruit today; a bowl of yam congee at lunch.

yangxu.zh: 谷雨寒湿伤阳,关节怕冷的注意保暖,别坐潮湿的地面。
yangxu.en: Cold-damp at Grain Rain taxes yang: keep joints warm and don't sit on damp ground.

yinxu.zh: 春末燥热初现,阴虚者多喝水,少吃香椿等发散之物。
yinxu.en: Late-spring heat begins: drink more water and limit dispersing foods like toon shoots.

tanshi.zh: 谷雨是祛湿关键期,今天来碗薏米赤小豆汤,别碰甜饮。
tanshi.en: Grain Rain is prime time to drain damp: Job's tears and adzuki soup today, no sugary drinks.

shire.zh: 湿热渐盛,饮食清淡利湿,多吃冬瓜、黄瓜,少辣少油。
shire.en: Damp-heat gathers: light, damp-draining meals with winter melon and cucumber; little chili or oil.

xueyu.zh: 阴雨连绵血行易滞,室内活动别停,每小时起身走动。
xueyu.en: Persistent rain slows the blood: keep moving indoors, stand up every hour.

qiyu.zh: 谷雨前后易困倦低落,午后听听音乐、泡杯玫瑰花茶。
qiyu.en: Grain Rain can bring sluggish moods: music in the afternoon and a cup of rose tea.

tebing.zh: 潮湿加花粉,过敏双重压力,今天室内除湿、通风,出门戴口罩。
tebing.en: Damp plus pollen is a double load: dehumidify and ventilate indoors; mask outdoors.

pinghe.zh: 立夏养心,午休 20 分钟,饮食清淡略带苦味。
pinghe.en: Start of Summer nourishes the heart: a 20-minute nap, light food with a touch of bitter.

qixu.zh: 初夏渐热易乏力,气虚者别剧烈运动,午休必不可少。
qixu.en: Early heat saps energy: no strenuous exercise; the midday nap is non-negotiable.

yangxu.zh: 立夏别急着开空调、吃冷饮,阳虚者此时养阳事半功倍。
yangxu.en: Don't rush into air-con and iced drinks: this is when yang deficiency builds warmth most easily.

yinxu.zh: 心火渐旺、睡眠变浅,今晚莲子百合粥,睡前别看手机。
yinxu.en: Heart fire rises and sleep lightens: lotus-seed lily congee tonight, no phone before bed.

tanshi.zh: 天热出汗正好化湿,今天运动到微汗,少喝含糖饮料。
tanshi.en: Sweat clears damp: exercise to a light sweat today, skip sugary drinks.

shire.zh: 湿热体质进入难熬季,饮食清淡,苦瓜、绿豆上桌,衣物勤换。
shire.en: A hard season begins for damp-heat: light meals with bitter melon and mung bean, fresh clothes often.

xueyu.zh: 天暖血行畅,多活动,别久坐空调房。
xueyu.en: Warmth moves the blood: be active and don't sit all day in air-conditioning.

qiyu.zh: 立夏日长,多去户外、多见人,心情会跟着亮起来。
qiyu.en: Longer days at Start of Summer: more outdoors, more people, and mood follows the light.

tebing.zh: 花粉季尾声,但紫外线和汗水易刺激皮肤,做好防晒,及时擦汗。
tebing.en: Pollen eases, but sun and sweat irritate skin: sunscreen on, dry off promptly.

pinghe.zh: 小满湿热渐起,饮食清淡利湿,少辛辣甜腻。
pinghe.en: Damp-heat builds at Grain Buds: eat light and damp-draining, less spice and sugar.

qixu.zh: 闷热耗气,少量多次喝温水,别等渴了才喝,避免正午外出。
qixu.en: Muggy heat drains qi: sip warm water often, don't wait for thirst, avoid the noon sun.

yangxu.zh: 小满别贪凉,空调别对着吹,腹部盖好;姜茶可以继续。
yangxu.en: Don't overcool at Grain Buds: no air-con blasting, belly covered; ginger tea stays on the menu.

yinxu.zh: 湿热中夹燥,阴虚者多喝水,晚上吃点银耳或梨。
yinxu.en: Dryness hides inside the damp heat: drink more, white fungus or pear in the evening.

tanshi.zh: 小满是痰湿体质的减重期,管住甜饮和啤酒,今天走够 8000 步。
tanshi.en: Grain Buds is weight-loss season for phlegm-damp: no sugary drinks or beer, 8,000 steps.

shire.zh: 皮肤问题高发期,今天忌辛辣海鲜,薏米赤小豆汤,衣物透气。
shire.en: Peak season for skin complaints: no spicy food or seafood today; Job's tears and adzuki soup; breathable clothes.

xueyu.zh: 闷热易懒动,反而更要活动,早晚凉快时快走。
xueyu.en: Muggy weather tempts stillness — move anyway: brisk walks in the cool of morning and evening.

qiyu.zh: 湿热让人烦躁,午后一杯佛手玫瑰茶,深呼吸几次。
qiyu.en: Damp heat frays the nerves: Buddha's hand and rose tea in the afternoon, a few deep breaths.

tebing.zh: 汗多易起疹,保持干爽,穿棉质衣物,少吃海鲜。
tebing.en: Sweat can trigger rashes: stay dry, wear cotton, limit seafood.

pinghe.zh: 芒种闷热多雨,晚睡早起但务必午休,饮食清补。
pinghe.en: Grain in Ear is muggy: sleep a little later, rise early, always nap; eat lightly nourishing food.

qixu.zh: 湿热最耗气,气虚者今天别硬撑,午休 30 分钟,喝点冬瓜汤。
qixu.en: Damp heat drains qi hardest: don't push through today; a 30-minute nap and winter-melon soup.

yangxu.zh: 芒种雨多,阳虚者别淋雨、别吃冰,晚上泡脚祛寒湿。
yangxu.en: Rainy Grain in Ear: stay dry, skip ice, and soak your feet tonight to clear cold-damp.

yinxu.zh: 暑热出汗伤阴,多喝温水,鸭肉、莲藕都适合今天。
yinxu.en: Summer sweat taxes yin: warm water through the day; duck and lotus root suit today.

tanshi.zh: 湿重困脾,今天少吃甜腻,饭后散步,出点微汗最好。
tanshi.en: Heavy damp burdens the spleen: fewer sweets, a walk after meals, a light sweat is ideal.

shire.zh: 芒种是湿热最盛时之一,清淡、利湿、勤换衣,少熬夜。
shire.en: Among the dampest, hottest terms: light, damp-draining food, fresh clothes, early nights.

xueyu.zh: 闷热天别久坐,血行要靠动,每小时起来活动。
xueyu.en: Don't sit through the mugginess: blood needs movement, stand up every hour.

qiyu.zh: 梅雨季情绪易低,开灯、开窗、听音乐,别把自己关在屋里。
qiyu.en: The rainy season lowers mood: lights on, windows open, music playing — don't shut yourself in.

tebing.zh: 潮湿闷热助长霉菌尘螨,今天除湿、换床单,少吃发物。
tebing.en: Damp heat feeds mold and mites: dehumidify, change the sheets, limit trigger foods.

pinghe.zh: 夏至阳气最盛,防暑但别贪凉,运动放在清晨或傍晚。
pinghe.en: Yang peaks at Summer Solstice: beat the heat without overcooling; exercise at dawn or dusk.

qixu.zh: 长夏暑热耗气,少量多次补水,出门避开正午,别在烈日下久待。
qixu.en: Summer heat drains qi: sip water often, avoid noon, stay out of direct sun.

yangxu.zh: “冬病夏治”就在今天开始:不吃冰、不吹空调、腹部盖好,正午晒十分钟后背。
yangxu.en: Treating winter ailments in summer starts now: no ice, no air-con blasting, belly covered, ten minutes of noon sun on the back.

yinxu.zh: 夏至阴气初生,正是滋阴时,多喝温水,晚餐银耳、梨、鸭肉任选。
yinxu.en: Yin is born at the solstice — nourish it: warm water, and white fungus, pear or duck at dinner.

tanshi.zh: 大热天也别放纵冰饮,会加重痰湿;出微汗、吃冬瓜最好。
tanshi.en: Even in heat, iced drinks worsen phlegm-damp: a light sweat and winter melon instead.

shire.zh: 夏至湿热体质最难受,绿豆汤、苦瓜清热,别喝酒别熬夜。
shire.en: The solstice is hardest on damp-heat: mung-bean soup and bitter melon; no alcohol, no late nights.

xueyu.zh: 天热血行畅,正好多活动;别久坐空调房让寒凝血脉。
xueyu.en: Heat moves the blood — a good time to be active; don't let air-conditioning chill and stall it.

qiyu.zh: 心静自然凉,午后听音乐、泡杯玫瑰花茶,别把烦躁憋着。
qiyu.en: A calm mind cools the body: music and rose tea in the afternoon; let irritation out, not in.

tebing.zh: 紫外线最强,防晒做足;汗多勤擦,别让汗液刺激皮肤。
tebing.en: Peak UV: sunscreen on; dry off sweat often so it doesn't irritate the skin.

pinghe.zh: 小暑湿热交蒸,少量多餐、清淡易消化,荷叶茶解暑。
pinghe.en: Minor Heat steams: smaller, lighter meals and lotus-leaf tea to cool down.

qixu.zh: 暑湿让气虚者胃口差、乏力,今天少吃多餐,别省午休。
qixu.en: Summer damp dulls appetite and energy: small frequent meals today, and keep the nap.

yangxu.zh: 外热内寒最常见于阳虚者,冰饮一口都别碰,喝温绿豆汤。
yangxu.en: Heat outside, cold inside — typical for yang deficiency: no iced drinks at all; warm mung-bean soup.

yinxu.zh: 小暑汗多伤阴,多喝水,今天吃点酸甜:乌梅汤、西红柿。
yinxu.en: Heavy sweating taxes yin: drink more; something sour-sweet today — smoked-plum drink, tomato.

tanshi.zh: 湿热困脾最重的时候,饮食务必清淡,今天不碰甜食。
tanshi.en: Peak damp burden on the spleen: strictly light meals, no sweets today.

shire.zh: 小暑湿热体质易长痘口苦,薏米冬瓜汤、少辣少油、早睡。
shire.en: Minor Heat brings acne and bitter taste: Job's tears and winter-melon soup, little chili or oil, early bed.

xueyu.zh: 闷热别久卧,傍晚凉快时出去走走,活动肩背。
xueyu.en: Don't lie about in the heat: walk at dusk and loosen the shoulders.

qiyu.zh: 暑热令人烦躁,今天给自己一段安静时间,深呼吸、听音乐。
qiyu.en: Heat frays patience: give yourself a quiet stretch today — slow breaths, music.

tebing.zh: 高温高湿易起痱子湿疹,保持干爽,穿棉麻,少吃海鲜。
tebing.en: Heat and humidity bring prickly heat and eczema: stay dry, wear cotton or linen, limit seafood.

pinghe.zh: 大暑最热,补水为先,少量多次;西瓜适量,别过量。
pinghe.en: Major Heat is hottest: hydrate first, in small sips; watermelon in moderation.

qixu.zh: 酷暑耗气伤津,今天别出大汗,温水加一点盐,午休必不可少。
qixu.en: Extreme heat drains qi and fluids: avoid heavy sweating, lightly salted warm water, nap without fail.

yangxu.zh: “冬病夏治”黄金期:晒背、姜茶、不碰冰,阳虚者今天最该补阳。
yangxu.en: Golden window to treat winter ailments: sun your back, ginger tea, no ice — today is for building yang.

yinxu.zh: 大暑耗阴最甚,多喝水、多吃西红柿、梨,晚睡也要在 23 点前。
yinxu.en: Major Heat depletes yin most: drink more, tomato and pear, and even a late night ends by 11.

tanshi.zh: 大热出汗是化湿机会,运动放在早晚,别用冰饮把汗憋回去。
tanshi.en: Sweat clears damp: exercise morning and evening, and don't shut it down with iced drinks.

shire.zh: 湿热体质最难熬的节气,绿豆、苦瓜、冬瓜轮着吃,烟酒辣全停。
shire.en: The hardest term for damp-heat: rotate mung bean, bitter melon and winter melon; no alcohol, tobacco or chili.

xueyu.zh: 天热血行快,别久坐空调房,傍晚活动 30 分钟。
xueyu.en: Hot weather speeds the blood: don't sit in air-conditioning all day; move 30 minutes at dusk.

qiyu.zh: 酷暑易燥易怒,今天少安排、多留白,午后泡杯茉莉花茶。
qiyu.en: Heat shortens tempers: schedule less, leave room, and brew jasmine tea this afternoon.

tebing.zh: 防晒防汗疹,出门长袖防晒衣,回家温水冲洗。
tebing.en: Guard against sun and heat rash: long-sleeve sun shirt outdoors, lukewarm rinse when home.

pinghe.zh: 立秋暑未退、燥初起,饮食由清凉转润燥,梨和百合上桌。
pinghe.en: Heat lingers and dryness begins at Start of Autumn: shift from cooling to moistening — pear and lily bulb.

qixu.zh: 秋老虎耗气,别急着“贴秋膘”,先吃清补的山药、莲子。
qixu.en: The late-summer heat still drains qi: don't rush into heavy eating; yam and lotus seed first.

yangxu.zh: 立秋后早晚渐凉,阳虚者开始收起冷饮,早晨喝碗热粥。
yangxu.en: Mornings and evenings cool after Start of Autumn: put away cold drinks, hot congee at breakfast.

yinxu.zh: 秋燥是阴虚的大敌,从今天起多喝水,晚上一碗银耳羹。
yinxu.en: Autumn dryness is yin deficiency's enemy: from today drink more, white-fungus soup at night.

tanshi.zh: 立秋别跟风大吃,痰湿者仍以清淡为主,运动别停。
tanshi.en: Skip the autumn feasting: phlegm-damp stays light and keeps moving.

shire.zh: 暑湿余热未清,继续清淡,少辛辣烧烤,多喝水。
shire.en: Lingering damp heat: stay light, avoid spice and grilled food, drink water.

xueyu.zh: 秋凉渐至血行易缓,早晚快走,别久坐不动。
xueyu.en: Cooling slows the blood: brisk walks morning and evening, no long sitting.

qiyu.zh: 立秋易生悲凉,多见朋友、多晒太阳,别一个人闷着。
qiyu.en: Start of Autumn can bring melancholy: see friends, get sun, don't brood alone.

tebing.zh: 秋季花粉(豚草)开始,过敏体质提前防护,早晚戴口罩。
tebing.en: Autumn pollen (ragweed) begins: protect early, mask up morning and evening.

pinghe.zh: 处暑温差拉大,早睡早起,睡前温水,饮食滋阴润燥。
pinghe.en: Swings widen at End of Heat: sleep and rise early, warm water before bed, yin-nourishing food.

qixu.zh: 昼夜温差大最易感冒,气虚者早晚加衣,午后别贪凉。
qixu.en: Big day-night swings invite colds: layer up morning and evening, no overcooling at noon.

yangxu.zh: 处暑夜凉,阳虚者睡觉盖好腹部,别再开整夜空调。
yangxu.en: Nights cool at End of Heat: cover the belly in bed and stop running air-con all night.

yinxu.zh: 燥气渐盛、皮肤开始干,多喝水,少洗太热的澡,芝麻蜂蜜润一润。
yinxu.en: Dryness builds and skin tightens: drink more, skip very hot showers, sesame and honey to moisten.

tanshi.zh: 秋高气爽适合运动,今天走够 8000 步,少吃月饼类甜腻点心。
tanshi.en: Crisp air suits exercise: 8,000 steps today; go easy on sweet festival pastries.

shire.zh: 余热未消,鸭肉清补、冬瓜利湿,忌辛辣烟酒。
shire.en: Residual heat remains: duck to nourish gently, winter melon to drain damp; no spice, alcohol or tobacco.

xueyu.zh: 处暑后血行渐缓,久坐族今天每小时起身,晚上活动肩背。
xueyu.en: Circulation slows after End of Heat: desk workers stand hourly, loosen shoulders at night.

qiyu.zh: 秋意渐浓情绪易低,午后出门晒太阳,约人喝杯茶。
qiyu.en: Deepening autumn lowers mood: afternoon sun and a cup of tea with someone.

tebing.zh: 豚草花粉高峰,过敏体质外出戴口罩,回家洗脸换衣。
tebing.en: Ragweed peaks: mask outdoors, wash face and change clothes on return.

pinghe.zh: 白露身不露,夜凉别再赤脚,早晨一碗银耳或山药粥。
pinghe.en: White Dew: nights are cool — no more bare feet; white-fungus or yam congee in the morning.

qixu.zh: 白露后易感冒,气虚者早晚加外套,护好脚踝和后颈。
qixu.en: Colds rise after White Dew: a jacket morning and evening, cover ankles and the back of the neck.

yangxu.zh: 寒从脚起,阳虚者今天穿袜子、泡脚,晚餐加姜。
yangxu.en: Cold enters through the feet: socks on, foot soak tonight, ginger at dinner.

yinxu.zh: 秋燥正盛,阴虚者多喝水,银耳、百合、梨轮着吃,早点睡。
yinxu.en: Dryness peaks: drink more, rotate white fungus, lily bulb and pear, sleep early.

tanshi.zh: 秋高气爽正好运动化湿,今天出点微汗,少吃甜腻。
tanshi.en: Crisp weather is good for clearing damp: a light sweat today, fewer sweets.

shire.zh: 天凉也别贪辣,清淡一天,多吃莲藕、冬瓜。
shire.en: Cooler weather is no excuse for chili: a light day with lotus root and winter melon.

xueyu.zh: 凉意让血行变慢,早晚各活动十分钟,别久坐。
xueyu.en: Chill slows the blood: ten minutes of movement morning and evening, no long sitting.

qiyu.zh: 白露秋思起,把心事说出来,午后出门走一走。
qiyu.en: Autumn thoughts gather at White Dew: say what's on your mind and take an afternoon walk.

tebing.zh: 换季是过敏高发期,早晚戴口罩,回家先洗脸换衣。
tebing.en: Season change means allergy season: mask up early and late, wash face and change when home.

pinghe.zh: 秋分昼夜再平分,饮食平润,早晚添衣,多见朋友多晒太阳。
pinghe.en: Day and night balance again: eat mild and moistening, layer up, seek friends and sunlight.

qixu.zh: 秋分后夜长昼短,气虚者早睡养气,今晚 22:30 前上床。
qixu.en: Nights lengthen after the equinox: sleep early to restore qi, in bed by 10:30.

yangxu.zh: 秋分阳消阴长,阳虚者开始添衣、吃温食,核桃是今天的零食。
yangxu.en: Yang wanes after the equinox: add layers and warm food; walnuts are today's snack.

yinxu.zh: 秋分燥气最平和,正是滋阴好时机,芝麻、梨、百合都适合。
yinxu.en: The gentlest point of autumn dryness — ideal to nourish yin: sesame, pear, lily bulb.

tanshi.zh: 天气宜人,痰湿者多运动,今天走够 8000 步,晚饭七分饱。
tanshi.en: Pleasant weather for phlegm-damp to move: 8,000 steps, dinner at 70 percent full.

shire.zh: 秋分饮食宜平宜清,少辛辣油炸,莲藕、梨清润。
shire.en: Keep equinox meals mild and clean: little spice or fried food; lotus root and pear.

xueyu.zh: 凉爽适合活动,早晚各走一段,别让气血滞在沙发上。
xueyu.en: Cool weather suits movement: a walk morning and evening — don't let the blood stall on the sofa.

qiyu.zh: 秋分后日短,情绪易沉,白天多见光,晚上早点睡。
qiyu.en: Shorter days after the equinox weigh on mood: get daylight by day, sleep early at night.

tebing.zh: 秋季花粉未退,早晚戴口罩,卧室关窗开净化器。
tebing.en: Autumn pollen lingers: mask up early and late, bedroom windows shut, purifier on.

pinghe.zh: 寒露夜寒渐重,多吃梨、百合、银耳,睡前温水泡脚。
pinghe.en: Nights grow cold at Cold Dew: pear, lily bulb and white fungus; a warm foot soak before bed.

qixu.zh: 寒露易感冒,气虚者出门加外套,别赶时间快跑,早餐吃热的。
qixu.en: Cold Dew brings colds: a jacket out the door, no rushing, a hot breakfast.

yangxu.zh: 寒露阳气渐收,早晚护好腰腹和脚,今晚泡脚加姜。
yangxu.en: Yang withdraws at Cold Dew: keep lower back, belly and feet warm; ginger in tonight's foot soak.

yinxu.zh: 寒露燥气当令,阴虚者今天多喝温水,晚上一碗银耳羹。
yinxu.en: Dryness prevails at Cold Dew: warm water through the day, white-fungus soup tonight.

tanshi.zh: 秋高气爽正适合活动,今天走够 6000 步,少吃甜腻。
tanshi.en: Crisp autumn air is made for moving: 6,000 steps today, fewer sweets.

shire.zh: 天凉了也别贪辣,清淡一天,多吃莲藕和梨。
shire.en: Cooler weather is no excuse for chili: keep it light with lotus root and pear.

xueyu.zh: 寒露久坐伤血,每小时起来活动 3 分钟,晚上活动肩背。
xueyu.en: Long sitting stagnates blood at Cold Dew: stand 3 minutes every hour, loosen shoulders at night.

qiyu.zh: 寒露秋意浓,情绪易低,午后出门晒太阳,约个朋友。
qiyu.en: Deep autumn at Cold Dew lowers spirits: afternoon sun and call a friend.

tebing.zh: 换季过敏高发,早晚戴口罩,回家洗脸,卧室勤换床单。
tebing.en: Season-change allergies peak: mask early and late, wash your face when home, change sheets often.

pinghe.zh: 霜降昼夜温差大,护住脖颈腰腹和脚,饮食平补,芝麻山药梨。
pinghe.en: Big swings at Frost's Descent: cover neck, waist and feet; gentle nourishment — sesame, yam, pear.

qixu.zh: 霜降是秋季最后一个节气,气虚者早晚添衣,午餐来碗黄芪鸡汤。
qixu.en: Autumn's last term: layer up morning and evening; astragalus chicken soup at lunch.

yangxu.zh: “补冬不如补霜降”,阳虚者今晚羊肉汤、泡脚,护好腰腹和脚。
yangxu.en: Tonify at Frost's Descent rather than waiting for winter: lamb soup tonight, foot soak, keep lower back and feet warm.

yinxu.zh: 霜降燥与寒并至,阴虚者滋阴润燥为先,银耳、芝麻,少辛辣。
yinxu.en: Dryness meets cold: nourish yin first — white fungus, sesame, little spice.

tanshi.zh: 霜降进补季来了,痰湿者别跟着大补,清淡为主,运动别停。
tanshi.en: Tonifying season arrives, but phlegm-damp should stay light and keep moving.

shire.zh: 天凉火锅季,湿热者仍要少辣少酒,多吃萝卜、莲藕。
shire.en: Hotpot season, but damp-heat still means little chili or alcohol; radish and lotus root instead.

xueyu.zh: 霜降寒凝血脉,出门前活动手脚,别久坐,晚上泡脚。
xueyu.en: Cold at Frost's Descent stalls the blood: move your limbs before going out, no long sitting, foot soak at night.

qiyu.zh: 霜降万物萧瑟,情绪易低,午后晒太阳,找人聊聊。
qiyu.en: Everything withers at Frost's Descent and mood dips: afternoon sun, and talk to someone.

tebing.zh: 冷空气刺激呼吸道,过敏体质出门戴口罩,回家温水洗脸。
tebing.en: Cold air irritates the airways: mask outdoors, lukewarm face wash when home.

pinghe.zh: 立冬进补季开始,温补为主别过量,早睡晚起,日出后再运动。
pinghe.en: Tonifying season opens at Start of Winter: warm food in moderation, sleep early, rise late, exercise after sunrise.

qixu.zh: 立冬寒风伤气,出门戴帽围巾,回家喝碗热汤,别空腹出门。
qixu.en: Winter wind drains qi: hat and scarf out, hot soup when home, never leave on an empty stomach.

yangxu.zh: 阳虚者的关键期,腰腹和脚保暖第一,晚餐羊肉汤,睡前泡脚。
yangxu.en: A key period for yang deficiency: lower back, belly and feet first; lamb soup at dinner, foot soak before bed.

yinxu.zh: 暖气一开更燥,阴虚者多喝水,温补选平和的:山药、黑芝麻。
yinxu.en: Heating dries you further: drink more, and choose mild tonics — yam, black sesame.

tanshi.zh: 立冬少动易生痰湿,室内也要活动,少吃肥甘厚味。
tanshi.en: Less movement in winter breeds phlegm-damp: keep moving indoors, go easy on rich food.

shire.zh: 冬季进补对湿热体质是陷阱,清淡为主,萝卜白菜是好朋友。
shire.en: Winter tonics are a trap for damp-heat: stay light; radish and cabbage are your friends.

xueyu.zh: 天冷血行迟缓,出门前先活动手脚,别久坐,晚上泡脚。
xueyu.en: Cold slows the blood: move your limbs before heading out, don't sit long, foot soak at night.

qiyu.zh: 立冬日短,情绪易低,白天多见光,晚饭后散步聊天。
qiyu.en: Short days at Start of Winter lower mood: daylight by day, a walk and a chat after dinner.

tebing.zh: 冬天的过敏源是尘螨和干冷空气,勤通风、戴口罩、用加湿器。
tebing.en: Winter triggers are dust mites and cold dry air: ventilate, mask outside, use a humidifier.

pinghe.zh: 小雪天寒日短,温补配点萝卜防上火,白天多出门见光。
pinghe.en: Cold, short days at Minor Snow: pair warming food with radish, get daylight.

qixu.zh: 小雪寒气渐重,气虚者出门戴帽,早餐红枣小米粥,别熬夜。
qixu.en: Cold deepens at Minor Snow: hat on, red-date millet congee at breakfast, no late nights.

yangxu.zh: 阳虚者今天护好头、腰、脚三处,晚餐加姜加羊肉,早睡。
yangxu.en: Guard head, waist and feet today; ginger and lamb at dinner, early to bed.

yinxu.zh: 室内暖气干燥,阴虚者多喝水、用加湿器,温补别过头。
yinxu.en: Indoor heating dries: drink more, run a humidifier, don't over-tonify.

tanshi.zh: 小雪贪暖易懒,痰湿者室内也要动,少吃火锅肥肉。
tanshi.en: Warmth tempts laziness: move indoors, go easy on hotpot fat.

shire.zh: 小雪火锅季,湿热者少辣少酒,多配青菜萝卜。
shire.en: Hotpot season at Minor Snow: little chili or alcohol, plenty of greens and radish.

xueyu.zh: 寒凝血脉,久坐族今天每小时起身,出门前活动手脚。
xueyu.en: Cold stalls the blood: desk workers stand hourly, warm up limbs before going out.

qiyu.zh: 小雪情绪最易低落,白天多见光、多见人,晚上早点休息。
qiyu.en: Minor Snow is hard on mood: daylight and people by day, early rest at night.

tebing.zh: 干冷空气刺激鼻腔,出门戴口罩,室内保持湿度。
tebing.en: Cold dry air irritates the nose: mask outside, keep indoor humidity up.

pinghe.zh: 大雪严寒,出门戴帽围巾护好头和脚,晨起先在被窝活动手脚。
pinghe.en: Bitter cold at Major Snow: hat and scarf, warm feet; move your limbs before getting out of bed.

qixu.zh: 大雪寒风最耗气,减少清晨外出,出门全副武装,回家热汤。
qixu.en: Winter wind drains qi most: fewer early outings, fully wrapped when out, hot soup when home.

yangxu.zh: 阳虚者一年中最难的节气,腰腹脚三重保暖,晚餐当归生姜羊肉汤。
yangxu.en: The year's hardest term for yang deficiency: triple-cover lower back, belly and feet; lamb soup with angelica and ginger.

yinxu.zh: 大雪暖气燥上加燥,阴虚者多喝水,温补选黑芝麻、核桃,少羊肉。
yinxu.en: Heating compounds dryness: drink more, choose black sesame and walnut, little lamb.

tanshi.zh: 大雪少动多食最生痰湿,今天室内活动 30 分钟,晚饭七分饱。
tanshi.en: Less movement and more food breed phlegm-damp: 30 minutes indoors today, dinner at 70 percent.

shire.zh: 冬季进补与湿热相冲,清淡为主,萝卜、白菜、冬瓜。
shire.en: Winter tonics clash with damp-heat: stay light with radish, cabbage, winter melon.

xueyu.zh: 心脑血管高发期,血瘀者出门前活动手脚,别久坐,注意保暖。
xueyu.en: Peak season for heart and vessel events: warm up before going out, don't sit long, stay warm.

qiyu.zh: 大雪日最短,情绪最低,白天多见光,找人说说话。
qiyu.en: Shortest days and lowest moods at Major Snow: daylight, and talk to someone.

tebing.zh: 干冷空气和室内尘螨是两大过敏源,戴口罩、勤通风、换床单。
tebing.en: Cold dry air and indoor mites are the two triggers: mask, ventilate, change sheets.

pinghe.zh: 冬至一阳初生,静养为主,早睡,后背晒太阳,温补一餐别过量。
pinghe.en: Yang is reborn at Winter Solstice: rest, sleep early, sun your back, one warming meal without excess.

qixu.zh: 冬至养气关键日,别剧烈运动,早睡,早餐黄芪山药粥。
qixu.en: A key day to restore qi: no strenuous exercise, early bed, astragalus yam congee at breakfast.

yangxu.zh: 冬至阳气初生,阳虚者护住这一点阳:早睡、泡脚、晒后背,晚餐羊肉汤。
yangxu.en: Guard the newborn yang at the solstice: early bed, foot soak, sun on the back, lamb soup at dinner.

yinxu.zh: 冬至阴极,阴虚者滋阴正当时,黑芝麻、黑豆、桂圆少量,别大吃羊肉。
yinxu.en: Yin peaks at the solstice — nourish it: black sesame, black beans, a little longan, not much lamb.

tanshi.zh: 冬至饺子汤圆别过量,痰湿者七分饱,饭后散步。
tanshi.en: Festive dumplings in moderation: 70 percent full, then a walk.

shire.zh: 冬至进补是湿热体质的陷阱,清淡为主,一碗萝卜汤就好。
shire.en: Solstice tonics are a trap for damp-heat: keep it light — a bowl of radish soup is enough.

xueyu.zh: 冬至寒极血凝,出门前活动手脚,别久坐,晚上泡脚活血。
xueyu.en: Deepest cold stalls the blood: warm up before going out, don't sit long, foot soak to move the blood.

qiyu.zh: 冬至过后白昼渐长,情绪会慢慢回升;今天多见光,找人一起吃顿饭。
qiyu.en: After the solstice the days lengthen and mood follows: get daylight today and share a meal.

tebing.zh: 冬至室内久留尘螨多,通风、换床单、用加湿器,出门戴口罩。
tebing.en: Long indoor hours mean more mites: ventilate, change sheets, humidify, mask outside.

pinghe.zh: 小寒最冷,护好腰和脚,晚饭温补汤,早睡晚起等太阳。
pinghe.en: Minor Cold is among the coldest: lower back and feet warm, a warming soup at dinner, rise after the sun.

qixu.zh: 严寒耗气,气虚者减少清晨外出,出门戴帽围巾,回家喝热汤。
qixu.en: Severe cold drains qi: fewer early outings, hat and scarf, hot soup when home.

yangxu.zh: 小寒阳虚者全力保暖,腰腹脚三处不露,晚餐羊肉或牛肉,睡前泡脚。
yangxu.en: Full warmth mode at Minor Cold: lower back, belly and feet covered; lamb or beef at dinner, foot soak before bed.

yinxu.zh: 暖气房里更干,阴虚者多喝水、用加湿器,温补要平和。
yinxu.en: Heated rooms dry you further: drink more, humidify, keep tonics mild.

tanshi.zh: 小寒贪暖少动,痰湿者室内活动别停,少吃肥甘。
tanshi.en: Warmth tempts stillness: keep moving indoors, go easy on rich food.

shire.zh: 冬季火锅烧烤多,湿热者节制辛辣烟酒,多吃萝卜青菜。
shire.en: Hotpot and barbecue season: restrain spice, alcohol and tobacco; radish and greens.

xueyu.zh: 小寒寒凝血脉,出门前先活动手脚,别久坐,注意心脑血管。
xueyu.en: Cold stalls the blood: move your limbs before going out, don't sit long, mind the heart and vessels.

qiyu.zh: 小寒日短天冷,情绪易低,白天多见光,晚上早点休息。
qiyu.en: Short, cold days lower mood: daylight by day, early rest at night.

tebing.zh: 干冷空气刺激呼吸道,出门戴口罩,室内保持湿度、勤通风。
tebing.en: Cold dry air irritates the airways: mask outside, keep indoor humidity up, ventilate.

pinghe.zh: 大寒已近立春,进补收尾转平和,少油腻,多喝温水。
pinghe.en: Major Cold sits just before spring: wind down tonics toward mild food, less grease, warm water.

qixu.zh: 大寒仍冷,气虚者继续保暖,早餐山药粥,午后晒太阳。
qixu.en: Still cold at Major Cold: keep warm, yam congee at breakfast, afternoon sun.

yangxu.zh: 阳虚者别因“快立春”放松,腰腹和脚继续护好,晚上泡脚。
yangxu.en: Don't relax because spring is near: keep lower back, belly and feet warm; foot soak tonight.

yinxu.zh: 大寒进补收尾,阴虚者改回清润:银耳、梨、蜂蜜,多喝水。
yinxu.en: As tonifying winds down, return to light moistening: white fungus, pear, honey, more water.

tanshi.zh: 年节将至,痰湿者管住嘴,少甜腻,饭后散步。
tanshi.en: Festivities approach: watch the sweets and grease, walk after meals.

shire.zh: 年前聚餐多,湿热者少辣少酒,多吃萝卜解腻。
shire.en: Pre-holiday feasts: little chili or alcohol, radish to cut the richness.

xueyu.zh: 大寒血行迟缓,出门前活动手脚,别久坐,注意保暖。
xueyu.en: Sluggish blood at Major Cold: warm up limbs before going out, don't sit long, stay warm.

qiyu.zh: 大寒之后便是春,情绪也要准备回暖,今天见见人、晒晒太阳。
qiyu.en: Spring follows Major Cold — let mood start to thaw too: see people, catch some sun.

tebing.zh: 室内干燥尘螨多,通风、换床单、加湿;花粉季前开始洗鼻。
tebing.en: Dry indoor air and mites: ventilate, change sheets, humidify; start nasal rinses before pollen season.
